svg.title: The Oslo Accords (1993–1995): Gaza Strip & West Bank Areas A, B & C
svg.desc: GCSE History cartographic map showing the 1993–1995 Oslo I and Oslo II territorial arrangements across the Gaza Strip and West Bank: Area A (18%, Full PA Control), Area B (22%, PA Civil and Joint Security), Area C (60%, Full Israeli Control including settlements and the Jordan Valley), Jerusalem deferred to final-status talks, and the 1994 Israel–Jordan Peace Treaty.
